data.one_liner: Provides functions to validate and sanitize filenames for various operating systems.
data.what_it_does: The package checks filenames against OS-specific restrictions and can remove or replace illegal characters. It offers both validation and sanitization helpers for Windows, macOS/iOS (HFS), Android (FAT), and POSIX systems.
use_when: You need to ensure filenames are safe before saving them on disk
You support multiple platforms and want a single API for filename rules
avoid_when: You require advanced filesystem features beyond basic character checks
You need real-time streaming validation of filenames
strengths: Covers major OS filename rules in one library
weaknesses: Limited to character sanitization, no path handling
Package is still marked as in development
